title: The Mystery of Day and Night Animals
intro: This quiz follows Mia and Leo as they learn why some animals are active during the day, while others are active at night.

choices: An animal that is active mainly during the day
An animal that sleeps throughout the year
An animal that is active only underwater
An animal that comes out only in winter
questions.explanation: A diurnal animal is active mainly during the day.

choices: An animal that is active mainly at night
An animal that is active only in summer
An animal that cannot see in darkness
An animal that sleeps only during the day and night
questions.explanation: A nocturnal animal is active mainly at night.

questions.prompt: Which animal in the story was active during the daytime?
choices: The owl
The squirrel
The bat
The moth
questions.explanation: The squirrel was active during the daytime.

questions.prompt: Which adaptation can help an owl hunt at night?
choices: Brightly colored feathers
Large eyes, sensitive hearing, and quiet flight
Thick scales and a long tail
Gills and fins
questions.explanation: Large eyes, sensitive hearing, and quiet flight can help an owl hunt at night.

questions.prompt: Why are different animals active at different times?
choices: It helps them find food, avoid danger, and survive in their habitats
All animals choose their schedules randomly
Daytime animals cannot sleep
Night animals are afraid of sunlight
questions.explanation: Different animals are active at different times because it helps them find food, avoid danger, and survive in their habitats.
